SEPA Credit Transfer

This guide covers SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) processing.

SEPA enables euro-denominated payments across the Single Euro Payments Area.

Message Format

SCT uses the ISO 20022 pain.001 message format.

The message contains a group header and one or more payment instructions.

Group Header

The group header contains message identification, creation date, and control sum.

Field MsgId uniquely identifies the message.

Payment Information

Each payment instruction contains debtor information and credit transfer details.

Processing Rules

Banks must process SCT transactions within one business day.

The maximum amount per transaction is governed by the scheme rules.

Validation

IBAN validation is required for all account identifiers.
